title: Every Wrong Answer, I Got Smaller

lines.t: I got invited to the weirdest game show in town. Ten questions. Ten thousand dollars. But every wrong answer, you shrink.
My opponent? Mrs. Pickles. She's ninety one, and she has never lost at anything. Not even bingo.
The host was the Mayor. Question one. What color is a banana? Yellow. Easy!
Question two. How many hearts does an octopus have? I said one.
Wrong! Zap! Now I was as small as a fire hydrant.
Mrs. Pickles just said, three, dear. And she kept on knitting.
Question three. Does a shark have bones? I said yes. Zap! Now I was the size of a cat.
My best friend Benny laughed so hard, he fell off his chair.
Question four. I said pizza. I don't even know what the question was. Zap!
By question nine, I was the size of a hamster. The microphone was taller than me.
And Mrs. Pickles? She hadn't missed one. Was Mrs. Pickles getting taller? Nah.
The big screen said: Pickles, eight points. Me, just one.
Then a gust of wind blew away all the Mayor's cards. He grabbed the first one he could find.
Last question. Ten points. How many hearts does an octopus have?
Wait a second. I know this one!
Mrs. Pickles reached for her buzzer. But I jumped on mine with my whole body.
Three! Correct! Eleven to eight! Ten thousand dollars!
And every right answer makes you grow. So I grew right back.
And this part is real. An octopus really has three hearts. Two pump blood through its gills, and one pumps it to the rest of its body.
But Mrs. Pickles got eight right.
Now she's taller than the clock tower. Mrs. Pickles is knitting the tower a scarf.
Would you rather shrink, or grow?
